raj: FYI Acme Gamma flagged an unexpected charge after they downgraded Dedicated on Mar 3. They say they were billed pro-rated full month for reserved_pool and also didn't receive promotional onboarding credit. Invoice INV-2026-1209 shows reserved_pool (full month) $8,400 + onboarding_promo missing. Customer asks for correction + partial refund.
olivia: Can you attach invoice and the downgrade timestamp? Need to confirm pro-rate window.
raj: Attached: INV-2026-1209 (pdf) and events CSV. Downgrade recorded 2026-03-03T16:12Z. Billing system billed for 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 full reserved rate.
billing-bot: Invoice and events linked by @billing-sync: https://redwood.cloud/invoices/INV-2026-1209 (pdf) and https://redwood.cloud/events/EV-33421.csv
mike: Looks like provisioning job didn't pick up the downgrade until 03-06, so auto-prorate failed and they lost the onboarding promo of $500. I estimate a refund of pro-rated days (3/31 days) = $740 rounded + $500 promo credit = $1,240 total adjustment.
lina: Quick policy check: for onboarding promos we can apply a goodwill promo credit and separate refund for billing errors. OK to do both? Approvers: finance lead + accounting.
raj: Tagging @lina for approval. Customer prefers refund to card for the billing error and promo credit on next invoice if refund is slow.
lina: Approve. Use GL 4010 for pro-rate refunds and GL 4005 for promo adjustments.
mike: Running CLI to issue two actions: immediate refund $740 and promo credit $500.
```
billing-cli create-refund --invoice INV-2026-1209 --amount 740 --method pm_on_file --gl 4010 --note "pro-rated refund due to late downgrade"
billing-cli apply-credit --customer ACME-GAMMA --amount 500 --type promo --gl 4005 --note "onboarding promo reinstated (goodwill)"
```
billing-bot: Refund created: RF-2026-0231 (status pending). Promo credit created: PC-2026-078 (applied to customer account, will appear on next invoice). Linked to ticket FIN-7924.
raj: I'll message Acme Gamma with RF-2026-0231 and PC-2026-078 and estimated timeline 3-7 business days for refund.
mike: I'll monitor processor and attach payout confirmation when cleared. Marking FIN-7924 in progress.
lina: Thanks all. Please include this as a case example for the billing rules doc so we can reduce future incidents. :memo:
